name: outtake-flash
description: Check unfamiliar links for scams and phishing before your agent opens them, signs in, or pays. Adds the Outtake Flash MCP server and the outtake-flash skill.

interface.longDescription: Outtake Flash checks an unfamiliar link before your agent opens it, signs in, or pays, and returns a verdict with evidence. The plugin connects the Flash MCP server and adds a skill that says when to scan and how to act on each verdict.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this link is safe before I open it
